question: Can one baseline plasma pTau217/ABeta42 ratio predict future ADAS-Cog13 change beyond age, sex, APOE, diagnosis, and baseline cognition without using a single post-baseline byte?

denominator.definition: Participant gender / sex assigned at birth depending on phase
Clinical diagnosis at the baseline time point after phase-aware harmonization

outcome.label: future_adas_cog13_change
outcome.selection_rule: Choose the eligible outcome closest to index_date plus 24 months; break a date-distance tie with the earlier actual assessment date.
outcome.direction: Higher change means greater cognitive worsening.

time_contract.index_date: The latest actual collection or examination date among all retained baseline covariates and the frozen mechanism signature.
time_contract.feature_cutoff: No feature record with an actual date after index_date is allowed.

split_contract.family_group: required but unresolved in the public dictionary snapshot
split_contract.training_rule: All preprocessing, imputation, feature scaling, and model selection fit inside training sites only.
split_contract.bootstrap_cluster: site with participant nesting; family nesting must be added before execution

frozen_prediction_contract.primary_metric: Site-held-out difference in prediction error and calibration for 24-month ADAS-Cog13 change between the frozen denominator and denominator-plus-signature models.
frozen_prediction_contract.acceptance_rule: The mechanism signature must improve held-out prediction error with a site-clustered bootstrap interval excluding zero and remain calibrated across prespecified site and sex strata.
falsifiers: No incremental predictive value remains after the frozen denominator.
Calibration fails in any prespecified site or sex stratum.
Any mechanism-signature input is dated after index_date.
Any participant, site, family, or future time point crosses the train-test boundary.
The eligible family grouping cannot be lawfully reconstructed before outcomes are opened.

family_id.interpretation: No exact public dictionary match in this snapshot; this does not prove that no lawful relatedness solution exists after approved access.

post_baseline_leakage_sentinels.rule: Reject every candidate feature whose actual EXAMDATE, VISDATE, or COLDATE is later than index_date.
Treat every TOTAL13 after index_date as outcome-only; never use longitudinal ADAS values as predictors.
Treat post-index DIAGNOSIS, DXCHANGE, DXCURREN, BLCHANGE, CDRSB, MMSE, and FAQ as forbidden predictors.
Do not use USERDATE, USERDATE2, update_stamp, ID, or record_ID as biological, temporal, or participant features.
Never join longitudinal tables on VISCODE alone; require RID plus phase-aware time reconciliation and an actual date.
Do not treat a missing scheduled assessment as random; preserve table- and phase-specific -1, -4, -5, NA, empty, and zero encodings until adjudicated.
Do not fit imputation, scaling, biomarker thresholds, or feature selection before the acquisition-site split.
Do not let a rollover participant, duplicate RID, family cluster, or enrollment site occur in both training and holdout partitions.
Do not use CDR to independently grade a diagnostic outcome without modeling their documented criterion dependence.

interpretation_boundaries: This packet freezes a public variable/timepoint contract and leakage sentinels only.
Public dictionary presence does not prove row-level completeness, temporal eligibility, assay comparability, or lawful access.
A missing FAMILYID dictionary match is an unresolved grouping state, not proof that participants are unrelated.
Prediction beyond a denominator would not establish a neurodegenerative root cause, mediation, treatment effect, diagnosis, or clinical utility.
No participant data, model training, biomarker thresholding, diagnosis, treatment recommendation, or solved-frontier claim is performed.
